title: Hashima Island
description: Thousands of people once lived on this tiny concrete island. Hashima, off Nagasaki, has been empty since 1974. Imagery: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics. Photos: Jakub Halun (CC BY 4.0), Jordy Meow (CC BY-SA 3.0), Wikimedia Commons. Source: Wikipedia.

beats.text: Thousands of people once lived on this tiny concrete island.
It is Hashima, off Nagasaki. Its nickname is Battleship Island.
The whole island covers just sixteen acres.
Under it, coal mines ran a kilometer deep, below the sea.
In nineteen fifty nine, more than five thousand people were packed in here.
During the war, forced laborers worked these mines in brutal conditions.
Then the coal ran out. In nineteen seventy four the mine closed, and everyone left.
